subject: [RFC PATCH 1/1] mm/swap: allocate contiguous swap slots for a reclaim batch

reviews.author: Alexandre Ghiti
reviews.summary:
Reviewer noted that the folio_alloc_swap_split() function is not properly handling the case where a batch of LRU-adjacent folios spans multiple free clusters, and requested that the function be modified to allocate contiguous swap slots for such cases.

Reviewer Alexandre Ghiti noted that large folios have a separate allocation scheme and suggested adding this detail to the changelog.

Reviewer Alexandre Ghiti expressed a neutral sentiment by stating they would investigate the impact of this patch on zswap and writeback, but did not provide any specific technical concerns or suggestions.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Nhat,

On Fri, Oct 23, 2026 at 6:05 PM Nhat Pham <nphamcs@gmail.com> wrote:

---

Yes, large folio get their own allocation scheme, here the idea is to
"pack" small folios, I'll add that to the changelog.

---

I was wondering the same, I'll check how it impacts zswap + writeback.

Thanks!

Alex

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch optimizes swap slot allocation by allocating contiguous slots in batches, reducing the number of small write requests and improving performance. It achieves this by recording the number of pages of each order that need a slot before swapping out a batch, and then making those allocations follow contiguous free slots. This approach helps to minimize the fragmentation of swap clusters and reduces the overhead of small write requests.
